findings.title: Compact actions omit usage records
findings.description: The SDK compaction failure handler returns a failed result without recording telemetry attached to the provider error, so spend before failure is lost. The prompt-only path also runs `claude_agent_sdk.query()` without collecting or stamping usage. Since compact is classified as an LLM action in `sq stats run`, these paths can make reported usage incomplete.

findings.title: Malformed cost-basis values can abort the reviews report
findings.description: `_basis` checks membership in a set without validating that the frontmatter value is hashable. A YAML list or mapping for `costBasis` raises `TypeError` instead of warning and treating the field as unreported, aborting the entire `sq stats reviews` report. The malformed-field test covers a string value, but not an unhashable one.

findings.title: An unreadable review artifact can abort the report
findings.description: `read_frontmatter` performs file I/O and can raise `OSError`, but this loop only handles a `None` parse result. If an artifact cannot be read, the exception escapes and prevents the report from showing other readable artifacts, rather than counting the file as skipped and logging a warning.
